name: Shield Guard
notes: Basic attacks bounce off its shield. A Strike or a Perfect Counter breaks the shield; it grows back after 6 seconds.
description: A shadow knight that hides behind a heavy shield. A Strike or a Perfect Counter breaks it.

bestiary.tip: When the shield breaks, the guard is open. Be ready.

lore.white: These guards stand where the old doors once were. They still remember how to hold a line.
lore.yellow: Their shields grow thicker the higher you climb. Patience finds the opening.
lore.orange: The bravest guards stand here. Even the strongest shield cannot hide forever.
